shared_elements: low-relief motifs carved on the face of a large upright monolith
schematic curvilinear/geometric motifs arranged in horizontal zones or registers
elongated sinuous linear elements (band of repeated angled/zigzag lines in B; arcs and bands in A)
justification: Both surfaces are upright monoliths bearing shallow, schematic low relief organised loosely into stacked horizontal zones, and both use flat, outline-and-plane carving rather than modelled naturalism, which is the strongest correspondence. But the content differs fundamentally: A shows an anthropomorphic figure with head, headdress-like top, arms and concentric-disc and band motifs on a torso, while B shows profile animals (a quadruped, bird-like and other creatures) plus a band of repeated angled linear marks, with no human figure or disc.
